primary.title: Physics and Philosophy: The Revolution in Modern Science
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: A seminal work by Heisenberg himself, reflecting on the philosophical implications of quantum mechanics. Likely to be found in digital archives.

primary.title: Der Teil und das Ganze: Gespräche im Umkreis der Atomphysik
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: A collection of conversations and reflections by Heisenberg, offering personal insights into his scientific journey and the development of quantum theory. German original and translations are likely available.

primary.title: The Physical Principles of the Quantum Theory
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: An early and foundational exposition of quantum theory by Heisenberg, crucial for understanding his contributions. Likely to be digitized.

secondary.title: Heisenberg's Uncertainties: A Scientific Biography
secondary.author: David C. Cassidy
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded biography of Heisenberg, offering deep insights into his life and work from a scholarly perspective.

secondary.title: Quantum Generations: A History of Nuclear Physics
secondary.author: Helge Kragh
secondary.rationale: This book provides historical context for Heisenberg's work within the broader field of nuclear physics, written by a prominent historian of science.

secondary.title: The Road to Reality: A Complete Guide to Physics
secondary.author: Roger Penrose
secondary.rationale: While not solely focused on Heisenberg, Penrose's work often discusses the foundational contributions of figures like Heisenberg to modern physics, offering a contemporary scholarly analysis.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are selected based on their significance and likelihood of being digitized. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly reputation and relevance to Heisenberg's scientific and historical context.
